meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Dial 平台操作一个真实电话号码：发送短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、接收短信和验证码，无需你自己配置账号或凭据。
howto.when: 当你说到短信、电话、验证码等词，或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等验证码时；也在你首次运行 dial 命令前自动加载。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 发短信，内容：明天下午三点见

say.note: 会发起 AI 语音通话。

say.text: 我要收一个验证码，帮我等着
say.note: 会等待入站短信并读取内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate a real phone number via the Dial platform: send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts and verification codes, without any account setup or credential handling.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention SMS, calls, verification codes, or ask to text/call/wait for a code; also loads before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Send a text to +14155550123: 'See you at 3pm tomorrow'
Call +14155550123 and say: 'Leave the package at the door'
Wait for a verification code and tell me when it arrives
say_en.note: Polls for inbound SMS and reads the body.
